topic: Breaking a lease the right way vs abandoning it (Dell vs Nadia)

scenes.narration: Walking out on a lease early cost one tenant eleven thousand dollars. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera in a courtroom beside a torn lease document and a bill stamped ELEVEN THOUSAND, comic burst banner reads LEASE BROKEN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Dell and Nadia both must move cities nine months into a year lease.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man dell and woman nadia each holding moving boxes, a calendar circled NINE MONTHS IN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Dell just stops paying rent and moves out overnight without a word.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man dell sneaking out of an apartment at night with boxes, an empty room behind him, comic banner reads NO NOTICE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His landlord keeps the deposit and sues for every remaining month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an angry landlord at a desk holding a lawsuit folder, a deposit envelope stamped KEPT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nadia rereads her lease and finds an early termination clause.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman nadia at a kitchen table reading a lease, a highlighted line reads EARLY TERMINATION CLAUSE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She gives written sixty day notice and offers to find a replacement.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman nadia handing a landlord a letter stamped SIXTY DAY NOTICE, a flyer reads ROOM AVAILABLE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nadia pays one clear termination fee stated in the contract.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman nadia signing a paper labeled TERMINATION FEE, a single neat stack of bills on the table, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The landlord re-rents fast and returns most of her deposit.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a smiling landlord handing woman nadia a deposit envelope stamped RETURNED, a new tenant moving in behind them, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Dell is sued for eleven thousand in unpaid rent and fees.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man dell shocked in a courtroom reading a judgment paper stamped ELEVEN THOUSAND OWED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The judgment wrecks his credit and follows him to new landlords.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a credit score gauge plunging into red, a rental application stamped DENIED in front of a worried dell, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nadia moves on clean with a reference from her old landlord.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman nadia smiling outside a new apartment holding a letter stamped GOOD REFERENCE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Read the termination clause and give notice in writing. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel, a clipboard reads NOTICE IN WRITING, comic burst banner reads DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
